source.text: שִׁמְעוּ־נָ֕א אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־יְהוָ֖ה אֹמֵ֑ר ק֚וּם רִ֣יב אֶת־הֶהָרִ֔ים וְתִשְׁמַ֥עְנָה הַגְּבָע֖וֹת קוֹלֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Hear, please, what Yahweh [is] saying: Arise, contend with the mountains, and let hear the hills your voice.

en.L: Hear, please, what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is saying: \q Arise, contend before the mountains, \q and let the hills hear your voice.
en.B: Listen to what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: \q Stand up, plead your case before the mountains; \q let the hills hear your voice.
en.R: Listen to what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is saying: \q Stand up and present your case to the mountains. \q Let the hills hear what you have to say.

vi.L: Xin hãy nghe điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đang phán: \q Hãy chỗi dậy, hãy tranh tụng trước các núi, \q và để các đồi nghe tiếng ngươi.
vi.B: Hãy lắng nghe điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: \q Hãy đứng dậy, trình bày vụ kiện của ngươi trước các núi; \q hãy để các đồi nghe tiếng ngươi.
vi.R: Hãy lắng nghe điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đang phán: \q Hãy đứng dậy và trình bày vụ kiện của con trước các núi. \q Hãy để các đồi nghe điều con muốn nói.

fr.L: Écoutez donc ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : \q Lève-toi, plaide devant les montagnes, \q et que les collines entendent ta voix.
fr.B: Écoutez ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : \q Lève-toi, plaide ta cause devant les montagnes ; \q que les collines entendent ta voix.
fr.R: Écoutez ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : \q Lève-toi et présente ta cause aux montagnes. \q Que les collines entendent ce que tu as à dire.

es.L: {{plural_you:Oigan|Oíd}} ahora lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: \q Levántate, pleitea ante los montes, \q y que oigan las colinas tu voz.
es.B: {{plural_you:Escuchen|Escuchad}} lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: \q Ponte en pie, defiende tu causa ante los montes; \q que las colinas oigan tu voz.
es.R: {{plural_you:Escuchen|Escuchad}} lo que está diciendo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: \q Ponte de pie y presenta tu caso ante los montes. \q Que las colinas oigan lo que tienes que decir.

sw.L: Sikieni, tafadhali, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anachosema: \q Inuka, ushindane mbele ya milima, \q na vilima visikie sauti yako.
sw.B: Sikilizeni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anachosema: \q Simama, ulete mashtaka yako mbele ya milima; \q vilima na visikie sauti yako.
sw.R: Sikilizeni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anachosema: \q Simama, ueleze shauri lako mbele ya milima. \q Vilima na visikie unachotaka kusema.

ko.L: 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀을 들어라. \q 일어나 산들 앞에서 변론하여라. \q 언덕들이 네 목소리를 듣게 하여라.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀을 들어라. \q 일어나 산들 앞에서 너의 사정을 변론하여라. \q 언덕들이 네 목소리를 듣게 하여라.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀을 들어라. \q 일어나서 산들에게 너의 사정을 말하여라. \q 언덕들이 네가 하는 말을 듣게 하여라.

pt.L: Ouçam, por favor, o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} está dizendo: \q Levanta-te, pleiteia diante dos montes, \q e que as colinas ouçam a tua voz.
pt.B: Escutem o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} diz: \q Fica de pé e defende a causa diante dos montes; \q que as colinas ouçam a tua voz.
pt.R: Escutem o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} está dizendo: \q Levanta-te e apresenta a tua causa aos montes. \q Que as colinas ouçam o que tens a dizer.

decisions.choice: plead your case before the mountains: a court case, with creation as witness
decisions.reason: The chapter opens a lawsuit. The word for "case" is a legal dispute, and the mountains and hills, which have stood through all of Israel's history, are called as witnesses, as heaven and earth are in Deuteronomy 32:1 and Isaiah 1:2 (compare Psalm 50:4). The LORD is the one who brings the charge (verse 2).

decisions.choice: Arise, plead: spoken to the prophet, who is to present the LORD's case
alternatives: spoken to Israel, which is to state its defense
decisions.reason: The command is masculine singular. The LORD most likely tells the prophet to stand and lay out the case before the mountains. It may also be addressed to Israel, invited to answer the charge, as verse 3 invites it to testify. The preposition may mean "before" or "with" the mountains.

decisions.choice: Hear, please (L); Listen (B, R); Arise (L); Stand up (B, R); contend (L); plead your case (B); present your case (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the polite "please", which in English reads as urgency. The legal sense is kept at every level (m1): Literal uses the verb "contend", Balanced and Readable a phrase with "case".

decisions.choice: the LORD's command to the prophet: "ngươi" (L, B) / "con" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision: the command is spoken to the prophet, who presents the LORD's case. The terms note gives God "ngươi" (L) / "con" (B, R) to a prophet; here the courtroom setting keeps "ngươi" at Balanced as well, so the summons sounds formal.

decisions.choice: "tranh tụng" (L); "trình bày vụ kiện" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision: a court case, with creation as witness; Vietnamese legal words keep the picture through 6:1-2.

decisions.choice: plural_you for "Hear" (to the people); "tú" for "Arise, contend" (to the prophet)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew turns from the plural to the singular; Spanish follows it.

decisions.choice: "변론하다" (L, B) and "고소", "변론" (6:1-2) for the LORD's lawsuit
decisions.reason: The scene is a court case with creation as witness (meaning decision); Korean keeps the legal words "변론하다", "고소" so the case can be followed through 6:1-5.

decisions.choice: pleitear, a causa (L); defender a causa, uma ação judicial (B); apresentar a causa, acusações (R); tu to the one told to stand
decisions.reason: For the lawsuit of verses 1-5 (m1): "pleitear" and "causa" are the Portuguese words of a court case, kept at every level as the English keeps the legal sense. The command is masculine singular, most likely to the prophet (m2), and the LORD's word to one person takes "tu".

source.text: שִׁמְע֤וּ הָרִים֙ אֶת־רִ֣יב יְהוָ֔ה וְהָאֵתָנִ֖ים מֹ֣סְדֵי אָ֑רֶץ כִּ֣י רִ֤יב לַֽיהוָה֙ עִם־עַמּ֔וֹ וְעִם־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יִתְוַכָּֽח׃

records.literal_gloss: Hear, mountains, [the] case of Yahweh, and [you] enduring [ones], foundations of [the] earth; for a case [is] to Yahweh with his people, and with Israel he will argue.

en.L: Hear, mountains, the case of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q and you enduring ones, foundations of the earth; \q for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has a case with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people, \q and with Israel {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will argue.
en.B: Hear the case of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, you mountains, \q you everlasting foundations of the earth! \q For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has a lawsuit against {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will argue it against Israel.
en.R: Listen, you mountains, to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s charges. \q Listen, you ancient foundations of the earth! \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has a case against {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people. \q He is bringing charges against Israel.

vi.L: Hỡi các núi, hãy nghe vụ kiện của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q hỡi các nền vững bền của đất; \q vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} có một vụ kiện với dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ tranh luận với Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Hỡi các núi, hãy nghe vụ kiện của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q hỡi các nền đời đời của đất! \q Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} có một vụ kiện với dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ đối chất với Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Hỡi các núi, hãy lắng nghe lời buộc tội của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. \q Hỡi các nền móng lâu đời của đất, hãy lắng nghe! \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} có một vụ kiện chống lại dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Ngài đang buộc tội Y-sơ-ra-ên.

fr.L: Écoutez, montagnes, le procès {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q et vous, immuables, fondements de la terre ; \q car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a un procès avec {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple, \q et avec Israël {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} va plaider.
fr.B: Écoutez le procès {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, montagnes, \q fondements éternels de la terre ! \q Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est en procès contre {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} va plaider contre Israël.
fr.R: Écoutez, montagnes, les accusations {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ! \q Écoutez, vous, les fondations anciennes de la terre ! \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est en procès contre {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple. \q Il accuse Israël.

es.L: {{plural_you:Oigan|Oíd}}, montes, el pleito {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q y {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, firmes cimientos de la tierra; \q porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tiene pleito con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo, \q y con Israel litigará.
es.B: {{plural_you:Escuchen|Escuchad}}, montes, el pleito {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q cimientos eternos de la tierra. \q Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tiene un pleito contra {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo; \q lo defenderá contra Israel.
es.R: {{plural_you:Escuchen|Escuchad}}, montes, las acusaciones {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. \q ¡{{plural_you:Escuchen|Escuchad}}, antiguos cimientos de la tierra! \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tiene un caso contra {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo. \q Presenta cargos contra Israel.

sw.L: Sikieni, enyi milima, shauri la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q nanyi mlio imara, misingi ya dunia; \q kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ana shauri na watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, \q {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} atahojiana na Israeli.
sw.B: Sikilizeni shauri la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, enyi milima, \q enyi misingi ya milele ya dunia! \q Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ana mashtaka dhidi ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}; \q atahojiana na Israeli.
sw.R: Sikilizeni, enyi milima, mashtaka ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Sikilizeni, enyi misingi ya kale ya dunia! \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ana shauri dhidi ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. \q Analeta mashtaka dhidi ya Israeli.

ko.L: 산들아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 고소를 들어라. \q 땅의 영원한 기초들아, [들어라]. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 백성과 다투실 일이 있으니, \q 그분께서 이스라엘과 변론하실 것이다.
ko.B: 산들아, 땅의 영원한 기초들아, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 고소를 들어라. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 백성을 고소하신다. \q 그분께서 이스라엘을 상대로 변론하실 것이다.
ko.R: 산들아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내세우시는 죄목을 들어라. \q 땅의 오래된 기초들아, 들어라! \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 백성을 고소하신다. \q 그분께서 이스라엘을 재판에 거신다.

pt.L: Ouçam, montes, a causa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, \q e vocês, os perenes, fundamentos da terra; \q pois {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tem uma causa com o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo, \q e com Israel {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} pleiteará.
pt.B: Ouçam a causa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, montes, \q fundamentos eternos da terra! \q Pois {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tem uma ação judicial contra o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} vai sustentá-la contra Israel.
pt.R: Escutem, montes, as acusações {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. \q Escutem, antigos fundamentos da terra! \q {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} tem uma causa contra o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo. \q Ele está apresentando acusações contra Israel.

decisions.choice: a case: a legal complaint, here the LORD's charge against his people
decisions.reason: The noun is the one in verse 1, and the verb at the end means to argue a case or reason it out (Isaiah 1:18). Hosea 4:1 and Jeremiah 2:9 use the same picture: the LORD brings a charge against his people for breaking the covenant.

decisions.choice: enduring foundations of the earth: the oldest and firmest things in creation
decisions.reason: The word means lasting, ever-flowing. The mountains were thought of as the earth's foundations, standing since creation (Psalm 104:5-8). They have seen everything the LORD has done for Israel and everything Israel has done.

decisions.choice: the case of the LORD (L, B); the LORD's charges (R); has a case with (L); against (B, R); argue (L, B); bringing charges (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "against", which is what the lawsuit means. "He will argue it against Israel" (B) begins after a semicolon, so "he" keeps the setting for pronouns for God.

decisions.choice: "pleito" (L, B), as Hosea 4:1 in Spanish
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word for a lawsuit is "pleito" in the published Spanish of the prophets.

decisions.choice: "shauri" (a case at law) and "mashtaka" (charges)
decisions.reason: The LORD's complaint is a lawsuit with creation as witness; Swahili uses the words of the law court, "shauri" and "kuhojiana", with "mashtaka" where the English says "lawsuit" or "charges".

source.text: עַמִּ֛י מֶה־עָשִׂ֥יתִי לְךָ֖ וּמָ֣ה הֶלְאֵתִ֑יךָ עֲנֵ֥ה בִּֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: My people, what have I done to you, and how have I wearied you? Answer against me.

en.L: My people, what have I done to you, and how have I wearied you? \q Testify against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}!
en.B: My people, what have I done to you? How have I made you weary? \q Testify against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}!
en.R: My people, what have I done to you? How have I been a burden to you? \q Tell me what I have done wrong!

vi.L: Hỡi dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã làm gì cho ngươi, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã làm ngươi mệt mỏi thế nào? \q Hãy làm chứng nghịch lại {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}!
vi.B: Hỡi dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã làm gì cho ngươi? Ta đã làm ngươi mệt mỏi điều chi? \q Hãy làm chứng nghịch lại {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}!
vi.R: Hỡi dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã làm gì cho ngươi? Ta đã làm ngươi khổ sở điều gì? \q Hãy nói cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} biết {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã làm điều gì sai!

fr.L: Mon peuple, que t’ai-je fait, et en quoi t’ai-je fatigué ? \q Témoigne contre {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} !
fr.B: Mon peuple, que t’ai-je fait ? En quoi t’ai-je lassé ? \q Témoigne contre {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} !
fr.R: Mon peuple, que t’ai-je fait ? En quoi ai-je été un fardeau pour toi ? \q Dis-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} ce que j’ai fait de mal !

es.L: Pueblo mío, ¿qué te he hecho, y en qué te he cansado? \q ¡Testifica contra {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}!
es.B: Pueblo mío, ¿qué te he hecho? ¿En qué te he fatigado? \q ¡Responde contra {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}!
es.R: Pueblo mío, ¿qué te he hecho? ¿En qué he sido una carga para ti? \q ¡Dime qué he hecho mal!

sw.L: Watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, nimekutendea nini, na nimekuchosha kwa nini? \q Shuhudia juu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}!
sw.B: Watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, nimewatendea nini? Nimewachosha kwa jambo gani? \q Shuhudieni dhidi {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}!
sw.R: Watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, nimewatendea nini? Nimewalemea kwa jambo gani? \q Niambieni kosa nililowatendea!

ko.L: 내 백성아, 내가 너에게 무엇을 하였으며, 무엇으로 너를 지치게 하였느냐? \q 나에게 불리하게 증언하여 보아라!
ko.B: 내 백성아, 내가 너에게 무엇을 하였느냐? 내가 무엇으로 너를 지치게 하였느냐? \q 나에게 불리한 증언을 해 보아라!
ko.R: 내 백성아, 내가 너희에게 무엇을 하였느냐? 내가 너희에게 무슨 짐을 지웠느냐? \q 내가 무엇을 잘못했는지 말해 보아라!

pt.L: Meu povo, que te fiz, e em que te cansei? \q Testemunha contra {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}!
pt.B: Meu povo, o que foi que eu te fiz? Em que te deixei cansado? \q Testemunha contra {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}!
pt.R: Meu povo, o que foi que eu te fiz? Em que fui um peso para ti? \q Diz o que eu fiz de errado!

decisions.choice: My people, what have I done to you? The accuser asks for the accused's defense
decisions.reason: The LORD brings the charge, yet he speaks first as if he were the one on trial: if his people have turned away, let them say what he did to deserve it. "My people" shows that the bond still holds. Jeremiah 2:5 asks the same: "What wrong did your fathers find in me?"

decisions.choice: wearied ... testify against me: what burden have I laid on you?
decisions.reason: To weary is to wear out, to burden (Isaiah 43:23-24). "Answer against" is a legal phrase: to testify against someone in court (Exodus 20:16; 1 Samuel 12:3).

decisions.choice: My people (no setting at the start of a sentence); Testify against me (L, B); Tell me what I have done wrong (R)
decisions.reason: "My" at the start of a sentence is capitalized either way, so it takes no setting; "me" later in the verse does. Readable says what the testimony would be about.

decisions.choice: God speaks to his people as "ngươi" through the lawsuit (6:3-5, 13-16)
decisions.reason: The terms note: "ngươi" at every level in rebuke. "Hỡi dân Ta" opens the sentence with "Hỡi", so "Ta" there is mid-sentence and keeps its span.

decisions.choice: "Dis-moi" with the deity_pronoun setting at Readable
decisions.reason: French puts a span on God's own pronouns wherever they stand mid-sentence, as the term sheet asks; the English Readable "Tell me" has none.

decisions.choice: "Pueblo mío" with "tú"
decisions.reason: God addresses his people as one person in the singular here, so Spanish uses "tú"; "Pueblo mío" puts the possessive after the noun and needs no deity_pronoun span.

decisions.choice: "Watu wangu" with the span on "wangu"
decisions.reason: In Swahili the possessive follows the noun, so "wangu" is not at the start of the sentence and takes the deity_pronoun span, though the English "My people" has none.

decisions.choice: tu for "my people" (verses 3-5)
decisions.reason: The LORD speaks to his people in the singular, as one, and in Portuguese his word to Israel addressed as one takes "tu" (docs/portuguese-style.md, section 4); the chapter goes over to "vocês" only where the Hebrew does (verse 16).

source.text: כִּ֤י הֶעֱלִתִ֨יךָ֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם וּמִבֵּ֥ית עֲבָדִ֖ים פְּדִיתִ֑יךָ וָאֶשְׁלַ֣ח לְפָנֶ֔יךָ אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֖ה אַהֲרֹ֥ן וּמִרְיָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: For I brought you up from [the] land of Egypt, and from [the] house of slaves I redeemed you, and I sent before you Moses, Aaron and Miriam.

en.L: For I brought you up from the land of Egypt, \q and from the house of slaves I redeemed you, \q and I sent before you \q Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.
en.B: For I brought you up out of the land of Egypt; \q I redeemed you from the house where you were slaves. \q I sent Moses, Aaron, and Miriam \q to lead you.
en.R: I brought you up out of Egypt. \q I bought you back from the land where you lived as slaves. \q I sent Moses, Aaron, and Miriam \q to lead you.

vi.L: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đem ngươi lên khỏi xứ Ai Cập, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã cứu chuộc ngươi khỏi nhà nô lệ, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã sai đến trước ngươi \q Môi-se, A-rôn và Mi-ri-am.
vi.B: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đem ngươi lên khỏi xứ Ai Cập; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã cứu chuộc ngươi ra khỏi nhà mà ngươi làm nô lệ. \q Ta đã sai Môi-se, A-rôn và Mi-ri-am \q dẫn dắt ngươi.
vi.R: Ta đã đem ngươi ra khỏi Ai Cập. \q Ta đã chuộc ngươi lại khỏi xứ ngươi làm nô lệ. \q Ta đã sai Môi-se, A-rôn và Mi-ri-am \q dẫn dắt ngươi.

fr.L: Car je t’ai fait monter du pays d’Égypte, \q et de la maison des esclaves je t’ai racheté, \q et j’ai envoyé devant toi \q Moïse, Aaron et Miriam.
fr.B: Car je t’ai fait monter du pays d’Égypte ; \q je t’ai racheté de la maison où tu étais esclave. \q J’ai envoyé Moïse, Aaron et Miriam \q pour te conduire.
fr.R: Je t’ai fait sortir d’Égypte. \q Je t’ai racheté du pays où tu vivais comme esclave. \q J’ai envoyé Moïse, Aaron et Miriam \q pour te conduire.

es.L: Porque te hice subir de la tierra de Egipto, \q y de la casa de esclavos te redimí, \q y envié delante de ti \q a Moisés, a Aarón y a María.
es.B: Porque te saqué de la tierra de Egipto; \q te redimí de la casa en que servías como esclavo. \q Envié a Moisés, a Aarón y a María \q para que te guiaran.
es.R: Yo te saqué de Egipto. \q Te rescaté del país donde vivías como esclavo. \q Envié a Moisés, a Aarón y a María \q para que te guiaran.

sw.L: Kwa maana nilikupandisha kutoka nchi ya Misri, \q na kutoka nyumba ya watumwa nilikukomboa, \q {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nikatuma mbele yako \q Musa, Haruni na Miriamu.
sw.B: Kwa maana nilikupandisha kutoka nchi ya Misri; \q nilikukomboa kutoka nyumba ulimotumikishwa kama mtumwa. \q Niliwatuma Musa, Haruni na Miriamu \q wakuongoze.
sw.R: Nilikutoa Misri. \q Nilikununua tena kutoka nchi ulikoishi ukiwa mtumwa. \q Niliwatuma Musa, Haruni na Miriamu \q wakuongoze.

ko.L: 내가 너를 이집트 땅에서 이끌어 올렸고, \q 노예들의 집에서 너를 구속하였으며, \q 너보다 앞서 \q 모세와 아론과 미리암을 보냈다.
ko.B: 나는 너를 이집트 땅에서 이끌어 내었고, \q 네가 노예로 살던 집에서 너를 구속하였다. \q 나는 모세와 아론과 미리암을 보내어 \q 너를 이끌게 하였다.
ko.R: 나는 너희를 이집트에서 이끌어 내었다. \q 너희가 노예로 살던 땅에서 값을 치르고 너희를 되찾았다. \q 나는 모세와 아론과 미리암을 보내어 \q 너희를 이끌게 하였다.

pt.L: Pois eu te fiz subir da terra do Egito, \q e da casa de escravos te redimi, \q e enviei diante de ti \q Moisés, Arão e Miriã.
pt.B: Pois eu te fiz subir da terra do Egito; \q eu te redimi da casa da escravidão. \q Enviei Moisés, Arão e Miriã \q para te guiar.
pt.R: Eu te tirei do Egito. \q Eu te comprei de volta da terra onde vivias como escravo. \q Enviei Moisés, Arão e Miriã \q para te guiar.

decisions.choice: I brought you up: an answer that sounds like the question
decisions.reason: In Hebrew "I brought you up" sounds almost the same as "I wearied you" in verse 3. The LORD's answer to his own question is a play on sound: he did not weary them; he brought them up out of Egypt.

decisions.choice: the house of slaves: Egypt, as the Ten Commandments name it
decisions.reason: The Ten Commandments begin "I am the LORD your God, who brought you out from the land of Egypt, from the house of slaves" (Exodus 20:2). To "redeem" is to buy back from slavery (Deuteronomy 7:8; 13:6).

decisions.choice: Moses, Aaron and Miriam: the leaders the LORD gave Israel in the exodus
decisions.reason: Moses led the people and gave the law, Aaron was the first high priest, and their sister Miriam was a prophet who led the women in praise at the sea (Exodus 15:20-21). Only here are the three named together as gifts of the LORD to his people.

decisions.choice: the house of slaves (L); the house where you were slaves (B); where you lived as slaves (R), as Exodus 20:2; redeemed (L, B); bought back (R); to lead you (B, R)
decisions.reason: Each level reuses its wording of the published Exodus 20:2, and keeps "slaves", since slavery itself is the point here. The verb "redeem" follows the wording set for the prophets. "Sent before you" means sent to lead them, which Balanced and Readable say.

decisions.choice: "nhà nô lệ" (L); "nhà mà ngươi làm nô lệ" (B); "xứ ngươi làm nô lệ" (R), as the published Exodus 20:2
decisions.reason: The meaning decision: Egypt named as the Ten Commandments name it, so the Vietnamese of Exodus 20:2 is reused at each level.

decisions.choice: "la casa de esclavos" (L); "la casa en que servías como esclavo" (B); "donde vivías como esclavo" (R)
decisions.reason: The words of Exodus 20:2 in Spanish; "esclavo" stays at every level because slavery in Egypt is the point.

decisions.choice: "노예들의 집" (L), "노예로 살던 집" (B), as the Korean Exodus 20:2 L; "구속하다" (L, B), "값을 치르고 되찾다" (R)
decisions.reason: Egypt is named as the Ten Commandments name it (meaning decision); the redeem words follow the term sheet for *padah* and *ga'al* alike.

decisions.choice: "nyumba ya watumwa" (L); "nyumba ulimotumikishwa kama mtumwa" (B); "ulikoishi ukiwa mtumwa" (R)
decisions.reason: The words of the published Exodus 20:2, which Micah recalls; "mtumwa" stays at every level because slavery in Egypt is the point (style guide).

decisions.choice: da casa de escravos (L); da casa da escravidão (B); onde vivias como escravo (R), as Exodus 20:2; Moisés, Arão e Miriã
decisions.reason: Each level keeps its Portuguese wording of Exodus 20:2, the words of the Ten Commandments this line echoes (m2), with "escravo" since slavery itself is the point. The three leaders take the forms of the Pentateuch.

source.text: עַמִּ֗י זְכָר־נָא֙ מַה־יָּעַ֗ץ בָּלָק֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ מוֹאָ֔ב וּמֶה־עָנָ֥ה אֹת֖וֹ בִּלְעָ֣ם בֶּן־בְּע֑וֹר מִן־הַשִּׁטִּים֙ עַד־הַגִּלְגָּ֔ל לְמַ֕עַן דַּ֖עַת צִדְק֥וֹת יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: My people, remember, please, what planned Balak king of Moab, and what answered him Balaam son of Beor, from Shittim to Gilgal, so as to know [the] righteous acts of Yahweh.

en.L: My people, remember, please, what Balak king of Moab planned, \q and what Balaam son of Beor answered him, \q from Shittim to Gilgal, \q so that you may know the righteous acts of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: My people, remember what Balak king of Moab plotted, \q and how Balaam son of Beor answered him. \q Remember the way from Shittim to Gilgal, \q so that you may know the saving deeds of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: My people, remember how Balak king of Moab planned to harm you, \q and how Balaam son of Beor answered him with blessings. \q Remember your journey from Shittim to Gilgal. \q Then you will know how {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} did what was right and saved you.

vi.L: Hỡi dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, xin hãy nhớ lại điều Ba-lác vua Mô-áp đã mưu tính, \q và điều Ba-la-am con trai Bê-ô đã đáp lại vua ấy, \q từ Si-tim đến Ghinh-ganh, \q để ngươi biết những việc công chính của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Hỡi dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, hãy nhớ lại điều Ba-lác vua Mô-áp đã âm mưu, \q và Ba-la-am con trai Bê-ô đã đáp lại vua thế nào. \q Hãy nhớ lại con đường từ Si-tim đến Ghinh-ganh, \q để ngươi biết những việc cứu giúp của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Hỡi dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, hãy nhớ lại Ba-lác vua Mô-áp đã định hại ngươi thế nào, \q và Ba-la-am con trai Bê-ô đã đáp lại vua bằng những lời chúc phước ra sao. \q Hãy nhớ lại hành trình của ngươi từ Si-tim đến Ghinh-ganh. \q Bấy giờ ngươi sẽ biết {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã làm điều công chính và giải cứu ngươi thế nào.

fr.L: Mon peuple, souviens-toi donc de ce que projetait Balaq, roi de Moab, \q et de ce que lui répondit Balaam fils de Béor, \q de Shittim à Guilgal, \q afin que tu connaisses les actes justes {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Mon peuple, souviens-toi de ce que tramait Balaq, roi de Moab, \q et de la réponse que lui fit Balaam fils de Béor. \q Souviens-toi du chemin de Shittim à Guilgal, \q afin de reconnaître les actes de salut {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Mon peuple, souviens-toi de ce que Balaq, roi de Moab, voulait te faire de mal, \q et comment Balaam fils de Béor lui a répondu par des bénédictions. \q Souviens-toi de ton voyage de Shittim à Guilgal. \q Alors tu sauras comment {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a fait ce qui est juste et t’a sauvé.

es.L: Pueblo mío, acuérdate ahora de lo que tramó Balac, rey de Moab, \q y de lo que le respondió Balaam hijo de Beor, \q desde Sitim hasta Gilgal, \q para que conozcas los actos de justicia {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Pueblo mío, recuerda lo que planeó Balac, rey de Moab, \q y cómo le respondió Balaam hijo de Beor. \q Recuerda el camino de Sitim a Gilgal, \q para que conozcas las obras salvadoras {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Pueblo mío, recuerda cómo Balac, rey de Moab, planeó hacerte daño, \q y cómo Balaam hijo de Beor le respondió con bendiciones. \q Recuerda tu viaje de Sitim a Gilgal. \q Así sabrás cómo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hizo lo que era justo y te salvó.

sw.L: Watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, kumbukeni, tafadhali, Balaki mfalme wa Moabu alichokusudia, \q na Balaamu mwana wa Beori alichomjibu, \q tangu Shitimu mpaka Gilgali, \q ili mjue matendo ya haki ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, kumbukeni hila aliyopanga Balaki mfalme wa Moabu, \q na jinsi Balaamu mwana wa Beori alivyomjibu. \q Kumbukeni njia kutoka Shitimu mpaka Gilgali, \q ili mjue matendo ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ya kuwaokoa.
sw.R: Watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, kumbukeni jinsi Balaki mfalme wa Moabu alivyopanga kuwadhuru, \q na jinsi Balaamu mwana wa Beori alivyomjibu kwa baraka. \q Kumbukeni safari yenu kutoka Shitimu mpaka Gilgali. \q Ndipo mtajua jinsi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyotenda yaliyo ya haki na kuwaokoa.

ko.L: 내 백성아, 모압 왕 발락이 무엇을 꾀하였으며, \q 브올의 아들 발람이 그에게 무엇이라고 대답하였는지 제발 기억하여라. \q 싯딤에서 길갈까지 [있었던 일을 기억하여라]. \q 그러면 네가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 의로운 일들을 알 것이다.
ko.B: 내 백성아, 모압 왕 발락이 무엇을 꾀하였는지, \q 브올의 아들 발람이 그에게 어떻게 대답하였는지 기억하여라. \q 싯딤에서 길갈까지 오던 길을 기억하여라. \q 그러면 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너를 구원하신 일들을 알게 될 것이다.
ko.R: 내 백성아, 모압 왕 발락이 너희를 해치려고 어떤 계획을 세웠는지, \q 브올의 아들 발람이 그에게 어떻게 축복으로 대답하였는지 기억하여라. \q 싯딤에서 길갈까지 너희가 걸어온 길을 기억하여라. \q 그러면 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 어떻게 옳은 일을 하셔서 너희를 구원하셨는지 알게 될 것이다.

pt.L: Meu povo, lembra-te, por favor, do que planejou Balaque, rei de Moabe, \q e do que lhe respondeu Balaão, filho de Beor, \q de Sitim até Gilgal, \q para que conheças os atos de retidão {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: Meu povo, lembra-te do que tramou Balaque, rei de Moabe, \q e de como lhe respondeu Balaão, filho de Beor. \q Lembra-te do caminho de Sitim até Gilgal, \q para que conheças os atos salvadores {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: Meu povo, lembra-te de como Balaque, rei de Moabe, planejou te fazer mal, \q e de como Balaão, filho de Beor, lhe respondeu com bênçãos. \q Lembra-te da tua viagem de Sitim até Gilgal. \q Então saberás como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} fez o que era certo e te salvou.

decisions.choice: Balak and Balaam: the king who hired a prophet to curse Israel, and got blessings
decisions.reason: Balak king of Moab hired Balaam son of Beor to curse Israel on the way to the promised land, but the LORD made Balaam bless them instead (Numbers 22-24; Deuteronomy 23:5-6). The LORD protected his people even when they did not know it.

decisions.choice: from Shittim to Gilgal: the crossing of the Jordan into the land
decisions.reason: Shittim was Israel's last camp east of the Jordan (Numbers 25:1; Joshua 3:1), where many sinned with the gods of Moab and yet were not destroyed. Gilgal was their first camp in the land after the LORD dried up the river (Joshua 4:19). The phrase sums up the LORD's faithfulness from the plains of Moab to the promised land.

decisions.choice: the righteous acts of the LORD: the deeds by which he kept faith and saved his people
decisions.reason: The word is a plural of "righteousness". Used of God's deeds, it means the acts by which he did right by his people, keeping his promises and rescuing them (Judges 5:11; 1 Samuel 12:7). They are the evidence in the LORD's case.

decisions.choice: righteous acts (L); saving deeds (B); did what was right and saved you (R); Remember the way (B); Remember your journey (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of "righteous acts" here (m3). The Hebrew has no verb before "from Shittim to Gilgal"; Balanced and Readable supply "remember" from the start of the verse. Readable says how Balaam answered (m1).

decisions.choice: "những việc công chính" (L); "những việc cứu giúp" (B); "đã làm điều công chính và giải cứu" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision: the deeds by which the LORD kept faith and saved; the names Ba-lác, Ba-la-am, Bê-ô, Si-tim and Ghinh-ganh are the published forms.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 의로운 일들" (L); "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 … 구원하신 일들" (B); "옳은 일을 하셔서 … 구원하셨는지" (R); "발락", "브올의 아들 발람", "싯딤", "길갈"
decisions.reason: The righteous acts are the saving deeds by which the LORD kept faith (meaning decision). In the LORD's own speech his name keeps -시- where it is the subject of a clause, as in Isaiah. Names as published in Numbers and Joshua.

decisions.choice: Balaque, rei de Moabe; Balaão, filho de Beor; de Sitim até Gilgal
decisions.reason: The names take the forms Numbers 22-25 and Joshua give them in Portuguese ("Balaão, filho de Beor", "Sitim"), so the reader can find the story the LORD recalls (m1, m2).

source.text: בַּמָּה֙ אֲקַדֵּ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה אִכַּ֖ף לֵאלֹהֵ֣י מָר֑וֹם הַאֲקַדְּמֶ֣נּוּ בְעוֹל֔וֹת בַּעֲגָלִ֖ים בְּנֵ֥י שָׁנָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: With what shall I come before Yahweh, bow myself to [the] God of height? Shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves sons of a year?

en.L: "With what shall I come before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q [and] bow myself to the God of the height? \q Shall I come before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with burnt offerings, \q with calves, sons of a year?
en.B: "What shall I bring when I come before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} \q and bow down before God on high? \q Shall I come to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with burnt offerings, \q with year-old calves?
en.R: "What should I bring to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} \q when I come to bow down to God in heaven? \q Should I bring {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} burnt offerings, \q young calves a year old?

vi.L: "Tôi sẽ lấy gì đến trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q [và] cúi mình trước Đức Chúa Trời trên nơi cao? \q Tôi sẽ đến trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} với các tế lễ thiêu, \q với những con bò con một tuổi chăng?
vi.B: "Tôi sẽ đem gì đến khi ra mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} \q và cúi lạy Đức Chúa Trời Chí Cao? \q Tôi có nên đến với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bằng các tế lễ thiêu, \q với những con bò con một tuổi không?
vi.R: "Tôi phải đem gì đến dâng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} \q khi tôi đến cúi lạy Đức Chúa Trời trên trời? \q Tôi có nên dâng cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} các tế lễ thiêu, \q những con bò con một tuổi không?

fr.L: « Avec quoi me présenterai-je devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q [et] me prosternerai-je devant le Dieu de la hauteur ? \q Me présenterai-je devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} avec des holocaustes, \q avec des veaux, fils d’un an ?
fr.B: « Qu’apporterai-je pour me présenter devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} \q et me prosterner devant le Dieu d’en haut ? \q Viendrai-je à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} avec des holocaustes, \q avec des veaux d’un an ?
fr.R: « Que dois-je apporter {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} \q quand je viens me prosterner devant le Dieu du ciel ? \q Dois-je {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} apporter des sacrifices brûlés, \q de jeunes veaux d’un an ?

es.L: «¿Con qué me presentaré ante {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} \q [y] me postraré ante el Dios de lo alto? \q ¿Me presentaré ante {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} con holocaustos, \q con becerros de un año?
es.B: «¿Qué llevaré cuando me presente ante {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} \q y me incline ante el Dios que está en lo alto? \q ¿Iré a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} con holocaustos, \q con becerros de un año?
es.R: «¿Qué debo llevarle {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} \q cuando vaya a inclinarme ante el Dios del cielo? \q ¿Debo presentar ante {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} holocaustos, \q becerros de un año?

sw.L: "Nije mbele ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na nini, \q [na] kujiinamisha mbele ya Mungu wa juu? \q Je, nije mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} na sadaka za kuteketezwa, \q na ndama, wana wa mwaka mmoja?
sw.B: "Nilete nini ninapokuja mbele ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} \q na kusujudu mbele ya Mungu aliye juu? \q Je, nije {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}} na sadaka za kuteketezwa, \q na ndama wa mwaka mmoja?
sw.R: "Nimletee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} nini \q ninapokuja kumsujudia Mungu aliye mbinguni? \q Je, nimletee sadaka za kuteketezwa, \q ndama wachanga wa mwaka mmoja?

ko.L: "내가 무엇을 가지고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 나아가며, \q 높은 곳에 계신 하나님께 [어떻게] 절할까? \q 내가 번제물을 가지고, \q 한 살 된 송아지들을 가지고 그분 앞에 나아갈까?
ko.B: "내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 나아갈 때 무엇을 가지고 가야 하며, \q 높은 곳에 계신 하나님께 절할 때 무엇을 드려야 할까? \q 번제물을 가지고, \q 일 년 된 송아지를 가지고 그분께 나아가야 할까?
ko.R: "내가 하늘에 계신 하나님께 절하러 갈 때, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 무엇을 가져가야 할까? \q 그분께 번제물을 바쳐야 할까? \q 한 살 된 어린 송아지를 바쳐야 할까?

pt.L: "Com que irei ao encontro {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, \q [e] me curvarei ao Deus da altura? \q Irei à presença {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} com holocaustos, \q com bezerros filhos de um ano?
pt.B: "O que levarei quando eu for à presença {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} \q e me curvar diante do Deus lá do alto? \q Devo chegar diante {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} com holocaustos, \q com bezerros de um ano?
pt.R: "O que devo levar {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} \q quando eu for me curvar diante do Deus que está no céu? \q Devo levar a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} holocaustos, \q bezerros novos, de um ano?

decisions.choice: With what shall I come before the LORD? The people's answer to the LORD's case
alternatives: the prophet speaking for the people
decisions.reason: After the LORD's charge (verses 3-5), a voice asks how the LORD can be appeased. It speaks for the people, as one worshiper. The questions grow more extreme until verse 7, and verse 8 gives the reply.

decisions.choice: burnt offerings, calves a year old: the costliest of the usual offerings
decisions.reason: A burnt offering was burned whole on the altar, nothing kept back (Leviticus 1). A calf in its first year was the best age for sacrifice (Leviticus 9:3). The worshiper starts with the best that the law asks.

decisions.choice: the God of the height: God on high, in heaven
decisions.reason: "Height" means the heights of heaven, where God dwells (Psalm 92:9; Isaiah 57:15). The worshiper is aware of how far above him God is.

decisions.choice: With what shall I come (L); What shall I bring when I come (B, R); God of the height (L); God on high (B); God in heaven (R)
decisions.reason: The verb means to come to meet someone, with a gift in hand; Balanced and Readable say "bring". The worshiper's words in verses 6-7 are set in quotation marks as speech quoted in the prophecy (m1).

decisions.choice: the worshipper says "tôi" and speaks of God as "Ngài"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision: the people's answer to the LORD's case, spoken about God rather than to him, so "tôi" fits, as in the Psalms.

decisions.choice: "Đức Chúa Trời Chí Cao" (B)
decisions.reason: "God on high" is not the title "'elyon" ("Đấng Chí Cao"); Balanced uses "Chí Cao" only as an adjective of height, and Literal keeps "trên nơi cao".

decisions.choice: The worshiper's questions (6:6-7) take « », as the English quotes them; God's answer in 6:8 does not
decisions.reason: Speech quoted inside the oracle takes quotation marks, as the term sheet says.

decisions.choice: the worshiper's questions (6:6-7) in « »
decisions.reason: Speech quoted inside an oracle takes « » in Spanish, as the English sets it in quotation marks.

decisions.choice: The worshiper's questions in the plain style with "나", speaking about God with -시-
decisions.reason: The people answer the LORD's case (meaning decision) by asking among themselves, not by addressing him, so the plain style fits; the quotation marks follow the English.

source.text: הֲיִרְצֶ֤ה יְהוָה֙ בְּאַלְפֵ֣י אֵילִ֔ים בְּרִֽבְב֖וֹת נַֽחֲלֵי־שָׁ֑מֶן הַאֶתֵּ֤ן בְּכוֹרִי֙ פִּשְׁעִ֔י פְּרִ֥י בִטְנִ֖י חַטַּ֥את נַפְשִֽׁי׃

records.literal_gloss: Will be pleased Yahweh with thousands of rams, with ten thousands of torrents of oil? Shall I give my firstborn [for] my transgression, [the] fruit of my belly [for the] sin of my soul?

en.L: Will {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} be pleased with thousands of rams, \q with ten thousands of torrents of oil? \q Shall I give my firstborn [to pay for] my transgression, \q the fruit of my belly [for] the sin of my soul?"
en.B: Will {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} be pleased with thousands of rams, \q with ten thousand streams of olive oil? \q Shall I give my firstborn for my rebellion, \q the child of my body for my own sin?"
en.R: Will {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} be pleased if I bring thousands of rams \q or rivers of olive oil? \q Should I give my oldest child for the wrong I have done? \q Should I sacrifice my own child to pay for my sin?"

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} có hài lòng với hàng ngàn con chiên đực, \q với hàng vạn dòng dầu chăng? \q Tôi có nên dâng con đầu lòng tôi [để chuộc] tội vi phạm của tôi, \q bông trái của lòng tôi [vì] tội lỗi của linh hồn tôi chăng?"
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} có vui lòng với hàng ngàn con chiên đực, \q với hàng vạn suối dầu ô-liu không? \q Tôi có nên dâng con đầu lòng của tôi vì tội ác mình, \q dâng đứa con do chính tôi sinh ra vì tội lỗi của mình không?"
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} có vui lòng không nếu tôi đem đến hàng ngàn con chiên đực \q hay những dòng sông dầu ô-liu? \q Tôi có nên dâng đứa con cả của tôi vì điều sai trái tôi đã làm không? \q Tôi có nên dâng chính con mình để đền tội không?"

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} prendra-t-il plaisir à des milliers de béliers, \q à des myriades de torrents d’huile ? \q Donnerai-je mon premier-né [pour] ma transgression, \q le fruit de mon ventre [pour] le péché de mon âme ? »
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} prendra-t-il plaisir à des milliers de béliers, \q à des dizaines de milliers de ruisseaux d’huile d’olive ? \q Donnerai-je mon premier-né pour ma rébellion, \q l’enfant de ma chair pour mon propre péché ? »
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} sera-t-il content si j’apporte des milliers de béliers \q ou des fleuves d’huile d’olive ? \q Dois-je donner mon aîné pour le mal que j’ai fait ? \q Dois-je sacrifier mon propre enfant pour payer mon péché ? »

es.L: ¿Se agradará {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de millares de carneros, \q de miríadas de torrentes de aceite? \q ¿Daré a mi primogénito [por] mi transgresión, \q el fruto de mi vientre [por] el pecado de mi alma?».
es.B: ¿Se complacerá {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} con miles de carneros, \q con diez mil ríos de aceite de oliva? \q ¿Daré a mi primogénito por mi delito, \q al hijo de mis entrañas por mi propio pecado?».
es.R: ¿Se agradará {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} si {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} llevo miles de carneros \q o ríos de aceite de oliva? \q ¿Debo dar a mi hijo mayor por el mal que he hecho? \q ¿Debo sacrificar a mi propio hijo para pagar por mi pecado?».

sw.L: Je, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atapendezwa na maelfu ya kondoo dume, \q na makumi elfu ya mito ya mafuta? \q Je, nimtoe mzaliwa wangu wa kwanza [kulipia] maasi yangu, \q tunda la tumbo langu [kwa ajili ya] dhambi ya nafsi yangu?"
sw.B: Je, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atapendezwa na maelfu ya kondoo dume, \q na vijito elfu kumi vya mafuta ya zeituni? \q Je, nimtoe mzaliwa wangu wa kwanza kwa ajili ya makosa yangu, \q mtoto wa mwili wangu kwa ajili ya dhambi yangu mwenyewe?"
sw.R: Je, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atapendezwa nikimletea maelfu ya kondoo dume \q au mito ya mafuta ya zeituni? \q Je, nimtoe mtoto wangu wa kwanza kwa ajili ya mabaya niliyotenda? \q Je, nimtoe mtoto wangu mwenyewe kuwa dhabihu ili kulipia dhambi yangu?"

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 수천 마리의 숫양을, \q 수만의 기름 강을 기뻐하실까? \q 내 허물을 [갚으려고] 내 맏아들을, \q 내 영혼의 죄를 [갚으려고] 내 몸의 열매를 드릴까?"
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 숫양 수천 마리를, \q 강물처럼 흐르는 올리브기름 만 줄기를 기뻐하실까? \q 내 반역을 씻으려고 내 맏아들을, \q 내 죄를 씻으려고 내 몸에서 난 자식을 드려야 할까?"
ko.R: 내가 숫양 수천 마리를 가져가거나 \q 올리브기름을 강물처럼 드리면, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 기뻐하실까? \q 내가 저지른 잘못 때문에 내 맏아이를 드려야 할까? \q 내 죄를 갚으려고 내 자식을 제물로 바쳐야 할까?"

pt.L: Ficará {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} satisfeito com milhares de carneiros, \q com dezenas de milhares de torrentes de azeite? \q Entregarei o meu primogênito [em pagamento] pela minha transgressão, \q o fruto do meu ventre [pelo] pecado da minha alma?"
pt.B: Será que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} se agradará de milhares de carneiros, \q de dez mil rios de azeite? \q Devo entregar o meu primogênito pela minha rebeldia, \q o filho do meu corpo pelo meu próprio pecado?"
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} vai ficar contente se eu levar milhares de carneiros \q ou rios de azeite? \q Devo entregar o meu filho mais velho pelo mal que fiz? \q Devo sacrificar o meu próprio filho para pagar pelo meu pecado?"

decisions.choice: thousands of rams, ten thousands of torrents of oil: offers beyond all measure
decisions.reason: The offers grow past anything possible. Solomon offered thousands of animals at great feasts (1 Kings 8:63), but rivers of oil are beyond any king. Oil was poured on grain offerings (Leviticus 2:1). The worshiper thinks the LORD can be bought if the price is high enough.

decisions.choice: Shall I give my firstborn? Child sacrifice, the worst of all offers
decisions.reason: The nations around Israel sometimes sacrificed children (2 Kings 3:27), and the kings of Judah Ahaz and Manasseh did it (2 Kings 16:3; 21:6). The law forbade it as detestable to the LORD (Leviticus 18:21; Deuteronomy 12:31; Jeremiah 7:31). The worshiper's last question shows how wrong the whole line of thought is.

decisions.choice: my transgression ... the sin of my soul: my own wrongdoing
decisions.reason: The two words for wrongdoing follow verse 5's case: rebellion against the LORD and sin. "Soul" here means the self, the whole person: "the sin of my soul" is my own sin. "The fruit of my belly" is a child of one's own body.

decisions.choice: torrents of oil (L); streams of olive oil (B); rivers of olive oil (R); transgression (L); rebellion (B); the wrong I have done (R); the fruit of my belly (L); the child of my body (B); my own child (R)
decisions.reason: The word for transgression follows the wording set for the prophets. Readable says what giving the firstborn means (m2).

decisions.choice: *pesha'* "허물" (L), "반역" (B), "잘못" (R)
decisions.reason: Here the worshiper names his own wrongdoing (meaning decision); Literal uses "허물" as in Exodus 34:7 L, since "반역" sounds odd of one's own private sin; Balanced keeps the term sheet's "반역".
